title: What are the cube roots of 64, 512 and 729?
description: The cube roots of sixty four, five hundred twelve and seven hundred twenty nine are found by splitting prime factors into three equal groups. Keeko doubts the cube root of sixty four, because eight times eight is sixty four.
teaching_notes: One idea: a cube root is one of three equal groups of prime factors. Watch for students who split into two equal groups, as for a square root.

source: Find the cube roots of 64, 512 and 729.
video_script.why: The child finds cube roots by splitting repeated prime factors into three equal groups, including numbers that are perfect powers of a single prime.
video_script.substitution: Write the number as repeated prime factors, split them into three equal groups, and multiply one group.
video_script.anchor: three number cards, sixty four, five hundred twelve and seven hundred twenty nine
video_script.wrong_answer: the cube root of sixty four is eight
video_script.wrong_move: Keeko uses eight times eight, which is sixty four, and calls eight the cube root. A cube root needs three equal factors, and eight times eight times eight is five hundred twelve.
video_script.payoff_line: The cube roots are four, eight and nine

final_answer.spoken: the cube roots are four, eight and nine

video_script.design: One idea: three equal groups of prime factors, one group is the root. Wrong idea: two equal groups give a cube root. The three cards stay in the anchor band and the factor lines sit on the working board.

narration: <bookmark mark='groups'/>To find a cube root, we split the prime factors into three equal groups.
<bookmark mark='one'/>One group, multiplied out, is the cube root.
<bookmark mark='ex'/>Twenty seven is three times three times three, so its cube root is three.

narration: <bookmark mark='half'/>Step one, halve sixty four again and again. It is six twos.
<bookmark mark='group'/>Six twos make three groups of two twos.
<bookmark mark='root'/>Each group is two times two, which is four, so the cube root of sixty four is four.

marks.half: 512 is halved nine times to reach 1, giving nine 2s
marks.group: the nine 2s are circled in three groups of three
marks.root: each group 2 × 2 × 2 = 8 is written and the cube root 8 is marked

narration: <bookmark mark='half'/>Step two, halve five hundred twelve nine times to reach one. It is nine twos.
<bookmark mark='group'/>Nine twos make three groups of three twos, and each group is eight.
<bookmark mark='root'/>The cube root of five hundred twelve is eight.

marks.div: 729 is divided by 3 six times to reach 1, giving six 3s
marks.group: the six 3s are circled in three groups of two
marks.root: each group 3 × 3 = 9 is written and the cube root 9 is marked

narration: <bookmark mark='div'/>Step three, divide seven hundred twenty nine by three, six times, to reach one. It is six threes.
<bookmark mark='group'/>Six threes make three groups of two threes, and each group is nine.
<bookmark mark='root'/>The cube root of seven hundred twenty nine is nine.

narration: <bookmark mark='back'/>Step four, put the answers back in the question.
<bookmark mark='four'/>Four times four times four is sixty four.
<bookmark mark='eight'/>Eight times eight times eight is five hundred twelve.
<bookmark mark='nine'/>Nine times nine times nine is seven hundred twenty nine.

beats.on_screen: Answer: The cube roots are 4, 8 and 9
narration: <bookmark mark='ans'/>The cube roots are four, eight and nine.

narration: <bookmark mark='doubt'/>Keeko thinks the cube root of sixty four is eight, because eight times eight is sixty four.
<bookmark mark='third'/>But a cube root needs three equal factors, and eight times eight times eight is five hundred twelve.
<bookmark mark='fix'/>Only four, used three times, gives sixty four.
